current_goal_turn_classification: progress: actual cube dissemination and arbitrary noncoplanar source activity with explicit vanishing threshold
scope: The actual Wilson six-plaquette cell family is encoded on fine spatial period 4*n, n>0. Exact dyadic coordinates prove disjointness, six plaquettes per cell, affine transport and the literal correspondence between fine plaquette half-copies and coarse binary-label half-copies. The previous finite block extremal theorem is now fully instantiated with the actual Wilson priced transfer norm, with all symmetry and Schwarz hypotheses discharged. The fully marked model is quantitatively bounded using the nonnegative modified kernel bound and the original full physical norm lower bound. An arbitrary collection of cells has actual deleted-transfer norm at most exp(48*beta*envelope(beta)*number_of_cells) times the original physical norm. Among eight parity shifts every plaquette is internal for exactly two, so any finite marked plaquette set S has a selected subset A with |S|<=4|A| and an actual translated cell cover C containing A whose norm price is at most exp(48*beta*envelope(beta)*|A|). The original full ground and eigenvalue give supported decay M(Pf)<=rho^|S| M(f), where rho=exp(-beta*(R-96*envelope(beta))/4), beta>0, R>=96*envelope(beta), and f vanishes whenever any marked plaquette defect is below R. This holds for arbitrary noncoplanar patterns with no alignment premise. For arbitrary continuous f, the source-weighted event that every marked defect is at least 2R has mass at most 2*loss(f)+2*rho^|S|*M(f). Arbitrary finite pattern families share one loss charge and sum their cardinality activities. Defect-count tails in any finite spatial region pay the explicit binomial entropy, with a density estimate (2^b*rho)^k when region cardinality<=b*k. At R=192*envelope(beta), R tends to zero and rho=exp(-24*beta*envelope(beta))<=1/(2*beta+5) tends to zero. These are finite-regulator actual-source statements. A connected-contour count and the required response/interaction expansions, distant mixed-ground sum or signed physical replacement, independent global coercivity, physical scale matching, nonzero continuum survival and all twelve full Clay requirements remain open.

formal_results.WilsonCubeReflection.internal_not_crossi: Internal cell plaquettes cannot cross the canonical fine reflection seam.
formal_results.WilsonCubeReflection.positive_deleted: Actual positive fine deletion half-copy is exactly the positive coarse binary-label copy.
formal_results.WilsonCubeReflection.negative_deleted: Actual negative fine deletion half-copy is exactly the negative coarse binary-label copy.
formal_results.WilsonCubeTransport.deleted_pull: The complete cell deletion family transports exactly through every coarse translation and coordinate permutation.
formal_results.WilsonCubeChessboard.binary_bound: All abstract block-score hypotheses are discharged for the actual Wilson priced norm; the maximum is bounded by the empty or fully marked cell pattern.
formal_results.WilsonModifiedNormBounds.norm_le_one: Every nonnegative-coupling raw modified Wilson transfer has norm at most one.
formal_results.WilsonModifiedNormBounds.raw_full_le_ori: The unmodified raw transfer norm is bounded by the original physical transfer norm.
formal_results.WilsonCubeNormBound.full_score_le: The fully disseminated priced cell deletion norm is bounded by the original full physical norm using its quantitative lower bound.
formal_results.WilsonCubeNormBound.cellSet_norm: Arbitrary cell collections have actual deleted-transfer norm price exp(48*beta*envelope(beta)*number_of_cells), with no exterior-volume cost.
formal_results.WilsonCubeCover.matching_card: Each plaquette is internal in exactly two of the eight parity-shifted cell tilings.
formal_results.WilsonCubeCover.retained_quarter: Some parity-shifted tiling retains at least one quarter of every arbitrary finite marked plaquette set.
formal_results.WilsonCubeCover.retained_cover: The selected plaquettes lie in the explicitly constructed translated cell cover.
formal_results.WilsonClusterNorm.exists_cover: Every finite marked pattern has a selected quarter and a cover whose actual modified norm costs at most exp(48*beta*envelope(beta)) per selected plaquette.
formal_results.WilsonClusterSourceDecay.intersection_de: Arbitrary noncoplanar marked patterns have original-ground supported decay rho^card(S), with beta>0 and R>=96*envelope(beta), rho=exp(-beta*(R-96*envelope(beta))/4).
formal_results.WilsonClusterSourceDecay.intersection_lo: The same actual high-defect support has lower variance loss (1-rho^card(S))*mass; this does not apply to arbitrary supports.
formal_results.WilsonClusterSourceTail.source_tail: Arbitrary-source simultaneous high-defect tails retain the original ground law and one actual variance-loss charge: 2*loss+2*rho^card(S)*mass.
formal_results.WilsonClusterCover.weighted_union: Arbitrary finite pattern families share one source loss charge and pay the sum of their full-cardinality activities; no alignment or independence hypothesis.
formal_results.WilsonClusterCover.union_decay: Sources supported on the union of hard pattern events have actual decay controlled by the summed pattern activities.
formal_results.WilsonClusterActivity.threshold_tendsto: The supported threshold 192*envelope(beta), hence also the hard-event threshold twice it, tends to zero as beta tends to infinity.
formal_results.WilsonClusterActivity.rate_bound: At that vanishing threshold, arbitrary-pattern activity is at most 1/(2*beta+5) for every beta>0.
formal_results.WilsonClusterActivity.rate_tendsto: The proved arbitrary-pattern activity tends to zero at weak coupling.
formal_results.WilsonClusterCountTail.binomial_tail: Any finite spatial region, with arbitrary plaquette orientations and positions, has a source-sensitive k-defect tail paying its exact binomial pattern count.
formal_results.WilsonClusterCountTail.density_tail: When a finite region has at most b*k plaquettes, its k-defect tail error is at most 2*(2^b*rho)^k*mass, with one loss charge.
formal_results.WilsonClusterCountTail.weak_coupling_tai: At a vanishing defect threshold, arbitrary-region density tails have explicit error 2*(2^b/(2*beta+5))^k*mass.

The concrete six-plaquette Wilson block instantiation, fully disseminated norm comparison and bounded-loss arbitrary-plaquette cover are now proved; the previous framed-chessboard report listed these as open at that time.
The arbitrary-pattern suppression and source-weighted tails hold on fine spatial periods 4*n with n>0. No extension to every other finite period is silently asserted.
The source loss term is retained. Rare-event probability by itself does not control an arbitrary concentrated source; the new bound is 2*loss(f)+2*activity*M(f).

The finite pattern-family activity sum and binomial count estimates are proved. A uniform rooted connected-contour count and the response/interaction weights needed in the distant mixed-ground estimate are not supplied by cardinality suppression alone.

Independent retained-region/global coercivity remains open, including gauge/toron directions and source-dependent boundaries. The source decay on high-defect supports is not a coercivity theorem for every source.
Physical scaling, multiscale stability, normalized reflected-state compactness and nonzero renormalized continuum survival remain separate obligations.
